Do NOT Huff Starter Fluid for Its Ether
I'm a mechanic. I couldn't sleep and tried hitting my starter fluid off a rag out of curiosity. Don't have much to say about the drug itself but every time I fucking breathe it has the smell of motor oil from a way-overdue oil change on a car or motorcycle. That shit has lubricants in it that are not pure ether and I failed to recognize the gravity of what that meant.
I'm smoking cigarettes to try to get rid of the smell. It's working very slowly. I did not even inhale enough to get noticeably high. Good lord is this a disgusting experience. I doubt I'll be able to sleep with this foul smell drifting out of my own lungs. I'm sure ether is a whole lot of fun but for fuck's sake it is an awful idea to inhale that crap in the form of starter fluid. I'm also probably going to get cancer.
